ai_summary: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia is a half-marathon event scheduled for November 1, 2026, in Putrajaya, Malaysia. The event starts in front of Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya, and registration is currently sold out.
